sources.species: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655
sources.note_en: E. coli pilot: published in local browser.
sources.note_zh: Rend-seq 文献整理记录；公开浏览器只显示 GEO 派生信号和候选端点，候选峰不等于终止子结论。

sources.species: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655
sources.note_en: The author summary integrates multiple experimental systems. Per-record experimental provenance cannot yet be separated reliably, so v0.2.0 publishes source metadata only and provides neither endpoint rows nor JBrowse.
sources.note_zh: 作者汇总表混合多个实验体系，逐条实验来源尚不能可靠拆分，因此仅保留来源审计。

sources.note_en: B. subtilis pilot: manual review 2026-08-06 re-derived the candidate set from raw WIG and re-verified checksums; candidates remain signal peaks, not terminator calls.
sources.note_zh: Rend-seq 候选端点已从原始 WIG 重算并核对；候选峰不等于终止子结论。

sources.note_en: C. vibrioides pilot: CP001340.1 authority; GEO copied NC_000913.2 line retained as issue.
sources.note_zh: 实验坐标以 CP001340.1 为准；GEO 中误写的 E. coli 参考版本作为元数据冲突保留。

sources.note_en: V. natriegens two-contig Rend-seq retains CP009977.1 and CP009978.1. Deterministic database-engineering checks for contig identity, strand, BED conversion, stable IDs and JBrowse resources passed in v0.2.0; no new biological reinterpretation was performed.
sources.note_zh: 双染色体数据保留 CP009977.1 与 CP009978.1；坐标和匹配严格限制在同一 contig。

sources.note_en: Warrier 2018 Supplementary Table S2 imported: 1,864 author-called Term-seq TTSs on NC_003028.3, called at coverage >=10 and >=2-fold enrichment over background.
sources.note_zh: 作者按覆盖度和富集阈值调用端点；同一物理位点可关联多个 locus。

sources.note_en: Lee 2019 Supplementary Dataset 3 imported independently: 1,640 author-called Term-seq TEPs on CP009124.1; termination and RNA processing are not distinguished.
sources.note_zh: 作者发表的是 Term-seq 3′ end position，不能据此区分转录终止与 RNA 加工。

sources.note_en: Table S1B imported as 1,965 reproducible Term-seq 3-prime sites; Table S1A retained separately as 805 gene-associated TTS rows although the article text reports 804.
sources.note_zh: 可重复 3′ 位点和基因关联解释分表保存；正文与补充表的 804/805 数量差异未被静默修正。

sources.note_en: Data Set S3 imported as 2,091 processing-filtered Term-seq TTSs across chromosome and four plasmids. Pure TransTermHP predictions remain excluded; article reports 617 predicted matches whereas TTS_list marks 616.
sources.note_zh: 公开层只包含作者过滤后的 Term-seq TTS；纯 TransTermHP 预测不进入数据库。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 Figshare Dataset 2 imported as author-called Term-seq TTS; BA000030.4 sequence is identical to RefSeq NC_003155.5.
sources.note_zh: 作者发表的 Streptomyces Term-seq 端点；BA000030.4 与对应 RefSeq 序列一致。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 author-called Term-seq TTS imported on NC_010572.1.
sources.note_zh: 作者发表的 Streptomyces Term-seq 端点，参考序列为 NC_010572.1。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 author-called Term-seq TTS imported on NC_003888.3.
sources.note_zh: 作者发表的 Streptomyces Term-seq 端点，参考序列为 NC_003888.3。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 author-called Term-seq TTS imported on CP009124.1.
sources.note_zh: 与 S1_007 使用相同物种和参考，但来自不同论文和作者表，保持独立来源。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 author-called Term-seq TTS imported on CP020700.1.
sources.note_zh: 作者发表的 Streptomyces Term-seq 端点，参考序列为 CP020700.1。

sources.note_en: Lee 2020 two-replicon endpoint table imported on CP027858.1 and CP027859.1.
sources.note_zh: 染色体与质粒两个 replicon 均保留在同一数据集和浏览器组装中。

sources.note_en: Coordinates verified on author-specified CP059991.1. Paper, ENA and ATCC label ATCC 15439 S. venezuelae; current NCBI GCF_015710995.1 / CP059991.1 labels it S. gardneri. Published with both labels and an explicit warning.
sources.note_zh: 坐标固定在 CP059991.1；论文与 NCBI 的物种命名差异作为分类学冲突保留。

sources.note_en: Hwang 2021 Data Set S1 imported independently: 1,427 author-called TEPs across CP027858.1 chromosome and CP027859.1 plasmid.
sources.note_zh: 与 S1_015 使用相同菌株和参考，但来自不同论文；作者特异测量值独立保留。

sources.note_en: Supplementary Data S2 imported: 487 TEPs across CP054306.1 chromosome and three plasmids.
sources.note_zh: 染色体和三个质粒的端点均按作者 replicon 标签映射，不合并坐标。

sources.note_en: Table S5 imported: 784 manually curated Term-seq TEPs on NC_000911.1.
sources.note_zh: 作者人工整理的 Term-seq 3′ end position，不表述为逐位点功能验证。

sources.note_en: Table S2D imported as 1,165 Nanopore native RNA 3-prime ends on NC_014500.1. The mixed-evidence S1C table is retained internally but excluded from public downloads and JBrowse.
sources.note_zh: 公开层只包含 Nanopore native RNA 3′ ends；实验与预测混合的 S1C 表仅留审计指纹。

sources.note_en: Supplementary Data 1 imported as 1,905 unique 3-prime RNA-seq end sites from 2,277 log and transition/stationary observations across 20 of the 22 reference replicons.
sources.note_zh: 唯一端点表与条件级观察表分层保存；结构和终止分数只作为作者附属注释。

sources.note_en: Table S3 Classification of TTS imported as 2,567 author-called Term-seq TTSs. AL123456.3 and NC_000962.3 sequences are identical, so coordinates are directly mapped to GCF_000195955.2 / NC_000962.3. Pure prediction-only RUT sites are excluded from public downloads and JBrowse.
sources.note_zh: 公开层只包含作者 Term-seq TTS；预测支持作为注释，纯 RhoTermPredict 位点不发布。
